## make a simple regression model

```{r}
bears <- read.csv(file="BEARS.csv",header = TRUE)
#adjust factors to be factors
bears$SEX<- as.factor(bears$SEX)
bears$MONTH<- as.factor(bears$MONTH)
```

## Model LENGTH ~ NECK  this is an example  

```{r}
plot(bears$LENGTH~NECK,data=bears, pch=18)
grid()
```

As the neck circumference of the bear increase, the length of the bear increase.   

```{r}
model.1 <- lm(bears$LENGTH~bears$NECK,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.1)
```

P-value is below 0.05 and the adjusted R-squared is 0.7476.  


Compare all models that predict LENGTH other than NECK.  
Then order them from worst to best by its value of Adjusted-Rsquared (bigger is better), or by RSE (residual standard error) where smaller is better. 

## Model LENGTH ~ HEADLEN

```{r}
plot(bears$LENGTH~HEADLEN,data=bears, pch=18)
grid()
```


As the length of the bear's head increase, the length of the bear increases.   

```{r}
model.2 <- lm(bears$LENGTH~bears$HEADLEN,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.2)
```
P-value is below 0.05 and the adjusted R-squared is 0.8434.   

## Model LENGTH ~ HeadWTH

```{r}
plot(bears$LENGTH~HEADWTH,data=bears, pch=18)
grid()
```

As the head width of the bear increases, the length of the bear barely increases.    
 

```{r}
model.4 <- lm(bears$LENGTH~bears$HEADWTH,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.4)
```

P-value is below 0.05 and the adj. R-squared is 0.5321.    

## Model LENGTH ~ CHEST
```{r}
plot(bears$LENGTH~CHEST,data=bears, pch=18)
grid()
```

As the length of the bear's chest increases, the length of the bear increases.

```{r}
model.4 <- lm(bears$LENGTH~bears$CHEST,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.4)
```

P-value is below 0.05 and adj. R^2 is 0.7869. 



## Model LENGTH ~ WEIGHT
```{r}
plot(bears$LENGTH~WEIGHT,data=bears, pch=18)
grid()
```

As the weight of the bear increases, the length of the bear increases. The curve slowly plateaus.

```{r}
model.5 <- lm(bears$LENGTH~bears$WEIGHT,data=bears)
summary.lm(model.5)
```

P-value is below 0.05 and the adj. R^2 is 0.7423. 

## Conclusion

Model LENGTH~HEADWTH R^2= 0.5321    
Model LENGTH~WEIGHT R^2= 0.7423    
Model LENGTH~NECK R^2= 0.7476    
Model LENGTH~CHEST R^2= 0.7869    
Model LENGTH~HEADLEN R^2= 0.8434
